routes.notes: Governance work may inspect browser-visible plugin state, formal reference tooling, runtime memory, and code structure context, but shell and envctl remain the primary actuators.

Formal paper review requires citation evidence and metadata lookup plus Zotero synchronization before final references are accepted. DOI is verified when present; user-provided sources, complete PDFs, and public academic index records can waive the must-have-DOI requirement.
Environment operations can use MCP evidence, agentmemory health, and codegraph context when relevant, but config mutation must remain governed by envctl and validators.

Project folder hygiene is filesystem and Git-state work. It should inventory and classify local project files without requiring MCP activation; browser, memory, and code-structure tools are only separate helper evidence if another confirmed route needs them.
Retrospective work may inspect evidence sources and runtime memory signals, but durable changes go through project-retrospective-evolver and vela-runtime-manager.
Browser tooling is optional for dashboards; process, logs, checkpoints, and shell probes remain primary.

Structured reading and citation evidence auditing require the formal metadata/Zotero chain. Browser, Google Scholar, and paper-search remain discovery or PDF-evidence sensors, not substitutes for the citation gate.

The citation evidence/Zotero/OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar chain is required for formal citation. DOI is checked when present; user-provided sources, complete PDFs, and public academic index records can waive the must-have-DOI requirement. Google Scholar and paper-search remain optional discovery sensors; CNKI discovery/download defaults to envctl cnki-zotero rather than direct cnki-mcp activation.

Fulltext acquisition uses DOI/OA metadata first. For English or international papers, OpenAlex/Crossref/Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar are the batch OA attempt; if no verified PDF is acquired, Google Scholar exact-title lookup and right-side PDF links become the default per-paper fallback. Zotero is only for explicit attachment or import planning. CNKI discovery/download defaults to envctl cnki-zotero and authorized Chrome/CDP rather than direct cnki-mcp activation. Browser selectors, local smoke-test status, and captcha checkpoint rules are governed by scholar_browser_patterns.json.

Research figure work defaults to local source files, code, SVG/PPT/HTML, and image2 when appropriate. MCP tools are not required unless the figure task also enters citation, data, or platform evidence routes.

Presentation work defaults to local files, the official Presentations plugin for PPTX, the installed original guizang-ppt-skill for HTML web decks, browser preview, and image2 when visuals are requested. MCP tools are not required unless the deck also enters citation, data, or platform evidence routes.
Browser-visible evidence is required; generic social capture is optional; VELA does not ship platform-specific social MCP backends.
MCP tools are sensors for literature and data discovery; reproducible local artifacts remain the controlled outputs.
Submission packaging requires the formal citation evidence verification chain before final bibliography and response artifacts are accepted.

Citation MCP tools are optional unless the project enters formal writing or citation evidence verification. DOI is checked when present; user-provided sources, complete PDFs, and public academic index records can waive the must-have-DOI requirement.
Corpus projects may use literature and paper search MCPs as discovery sensors, not as uncontrolled data sources.
Network analysis can use citation and literature MCPs for context, while node-edge definitions remain project artifacts.

Writing export requires reference capture and citation evidence verification before final output. DOI is checked when present; user-provided sources, complete PDFs, and public academic index records can waive the must-have-DOI requirement.
General research keeps MCPs as optional sensors until a more specific route selects stricter gates; runtime memory can help recall prior context but cannot silently switch route.
